source.author: Myshko, A.
source.title: МЕТАМОНИЗМ: Глава 1. Логические категории, оператор актуализации и возникновение первого инварианта
key_claims: D is the space of all possible configurations of differences
I is the space of identity conditions/invariants
R is a result of actualization
actualized distinguishable reality is the phenomenological starting fact

roots.claim: Complete identity is outside the nontrivial actualization domain of P.

active_chain.claim: An active actualization cannot terminate in contentually exhaustive identity.
Continued actualization must avoid contentual self-exhaustion.
Ordered distinguishable continuation gives temporal form.
Differentiation of continuation directions gives spatial/directional form.
Indefinite repetition along an exhausted direction approaches contentual identity.
Continuation therefore requires logically independent resolution.
Chapter 2 identifies orthogonal resolution as the processual form of this requirement.
Exhaustion of the current directional mode produces frustration.
Orthogonal resolution opens the next regime/state.

anti_inflation: The invariant constrains actualization, not the total possibility space.
Elements outside Dom(P) are not automatically globally impossible.
A possible configuration is not automatically an actualized state.
Chapter 2 consequences are scoped to continuing actualization.
D_perp is local to an actualized state and regime.
P4 is a trajectory state, not a universal fourth dimension.
next_frontier: Formalize the transition from contentual exhaustion to logically independent continuation.
Connect Chapter 2 orthogonal resolution to Chapter 3 without globalizing its scope.
